name: outline
description: Outline Server (Shadowbox) — Jigsaw's self-hosted Shadowsocks VPN. Runs with host networking on a TLS management API port + a Shadowsocks access-key port (TCP+UDP), managed from the Outline Manager desktop app. No subdomain, no nginx. Interactive install: pick the API and keys ports and confirm the public host. Your cloud firewall must allow both ports in.
